candidates.term: The Sage at the Hour Gate
candidates.defline: Care stands at your Hour Gate: what you show the future is teaching, given freely.
candidates.reading: This position rules Family, Growth, and Mind, and it shapes how your story ends. The Sage stands at your Hour Gate, visible in the last chapters: you end as the elder people consult, knowledge kept warm and given away. Children and students carry your teaching further than your name, which is the better vehicle anyway. Late growth comes through giving the learning form, classes, letters, a shelf of notes that outlives you. Protect the young deliberately, the way someone once protected you. History keeps the shelter you build. It is the one estate that never probates.
candidates.teaser: You will end as the elder people consult: knowledge kept warm and given away. Teach deliberately, because your protection of others is what history keeps.

domain_readings.Family: You end as the family’s consulted elder: knowledge kept warm and given away, protection extended to the third generation. Children and students carry your teaching further than your name. Teach deliberately in the last decades. History keeps the shelter you build.
domain_readings.Growth: Late growth gives the learning form: classes, letters, a shelf of notes that outlives you. The last era converts wisdom into artifacts. Make them physical. What you write down becomes the estate that never probates.
domain_readings.Mind: Your mind ages like a library in good hands: cataloged, warm, increasingly visited. Clarity holds because you keep lending it. Stay in circulation always, questions answered, letters returned promptly. The consulted mind is the preserved one.

candidates.life_chapter: Your late chapter is the teaching one: the last decades give away what the earlier ones gathered, and the giving is the glory. Expect to be consulted, quoted, and quietly beloved. Protect the young deliberately, the way someone once protected you. That is the estate.
candidates.relations: The sheltered young are this seat’s people: children, students, and strays who found warmth at your door. They will carry the teaching past your name, which is the better vehicle. Protect them deliberately. Someone once did it for you, and it made everything.
candidates.turn_catalyst: Run thin, the teaching stays oral: wisdom given, form ungiven. Write the notes this year. The shelf is the succession plan.
candidates.turn_friction: Run heavy, the giving empties the giver: everyone sheltered except you. Accept protection from the protected. They have been offering.
candidates.shadow_line: Overloaded, the elder becomes the archive: consulted often, embraced rarely.
candidates.health_line: Your late vitality flows from usefulness and rest in equal measure: teach mornings, nap afternoons, and the constitution carries you far past the tables.
